name: Prayer Book
description: The genre: a pocket book of the highest-signal condensed practice — prayer, meditation, mantra, or a practice guide — where every entry faces its explanation (what it is, how to do it, how to know it's working). The whole book fits the 110-page creative boundary; when content overflows, the answer is a second volume, never a fatter one. Practical Prayers and Tantric Prayer are the two members; more books generate from this template.

constraints.trim: 6x9 152.4x228.6mm; interior no-bleed; paperback cover full-wrap with 3.175mm bleed

paperback.spec: 6x9 cream B&W matte, 108pp target (KDP regular trim class); interior no-bleed; full-wrap cover from styles/cover-canonical.json (black ground, ivory type, Svatantrya logo centred on the back); kdp_preflight --expect-pages + check.py green before any upload

postcard.spec: GLOBAL-POST-GLOS-6X4 6x4in @300dpi, front = line + ref, back = explainer designed once

social.spec: 1080x1080 + 1080x1350 from exact entry, white ground, ink black, ref at foot

audiobook.spec: Per-entry English how-to clip, videofactory speaker format: Fish Audio TTS voice 'granny' (frozen ID 614f8afd83f841048c040b2c6234d2c1) reads the entry's how/howto block (the practice instruction). Same cache/receipts pattern as the verse clip. Digital edition plays verse -> how-to per prayer. Planned by factory.py audio; render after owner go.

chant.spec: Per-entry Sanskrit clip in the videofactory speaker format: Fish Audio TTS voice 'verse' (frozen ID 4e873c37d4cb439e9bccc4dc1f633290) reads the entry's IAST line. Render pattern copied from prx0r/videofactory render_chapter: one call per cached group, cache key sha1(voice|text), receipts appended to audio/receipts/calls.jsonl, VOICE_DB -21dB normalization. Planned by factory.py audio; API render only after owner go.

digital.spec: Digital edition for every book: (a) reflowable EPUB from bookkit HTML for Kindle/KDP ebook upload, (b) DRM-free PDF of the build-green interior for direct sale (one-link). Built after the build stage; cover, description and KDP ebook metadata are separate deliverables. Audio clips (verse + how-to) ship alongside when rendered. Customer package = package/ folder (EPUB + PDF + audio + manifest); see BOOKS.md 7b for the physical/Kindle/direct channel map.

series_pattern: One book = one thesis within the ceiling. When the material outgrows 110 pages, split into numbered volumes (thesis.series: {name, volume}) — same template, same style, consecutive claims — never expand a single volume past the ceiling.
inclusion: every entry faces its explanation: brief (C1 essence), what (sense), how (the text's own practice), sign (the text's own claimed effect) — feel optional
content is extract-and-place from named sources and layers; clarity-edits only after placing; no source = block stays off the page (fail closed)
whole book must preflight under the template page ceiling with the template style before the build stage opens
exclusion: no entry may appear in another book — one prayer, one book (cross-book id and IAST uniqueness is gate-enforced)
no agent-written prose anywhere in the entry fields; translations are ours, Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose is never printed beyond brief attributed quotation
no PDF build before content, structure, and formatting are confirmed — the build stage is the LAST stage of the pipeline, never the first

cover.house_constant: back cover = black ground + Svatantrya mantra-ring logo, small, centred; no back text, no second element
cover.swap_rule: replace meta.cover_image with the new book's emblem; leave styles/cover-canonical.json untouched so geometry and the back logo stay identical across the series
